The absence of salvage credit on failed traces is NOT the carrier of the non-amortisation: failed traces DO carry reusable information (measured ledger reuse rate r_failed = 0.17200 — 177404 of 1031432 failed-trace events have a candidate digest equal to some run's verified success), but crediting that value at the measured rate still leaves the verdict AMORTISATION_DOMINATED with zero recovering tiers. The ledger is not salvage-starved; the acquisition charge dominates.
